personalSite.title: Henry Lee Personal Website
personalSite.intro: A modern personal website integrating resume, project portfolio, AI tools, Medium article automation, and more, showcasing full-stack development and product design capabilities.

features.0: Built with Next.js 15 + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS, supporting App Router
features.1: Integrated self-developed AI tools including AI Dictionary and AI Requirements Analyzer

aiDictionary.title: AI Smart Chinese Dictionary
aiDictionary.intro: Using Google Gemini AI technology, enabling one-stop query of Chinese vocabulary meanings, etymology, example sentences, and multi-dimensional information, combined with learning card interaction to improve learning efficiency.

features.0: Query results cover meaning, etymology, examples, and multi-level information displayed as cards for easy learning and review
features.1: Supports learning mode, can mark 'Learning Complete' with undo support for repeated viewing
features.2: Real-time interactive animations with dynamic prompts for successful queries and completed learning
features.3: Rigorous error handling and query length limits ensuring query efficiency and accuracy
features.4: Integrated Google Gemini API for AI-powered Chinese vocabulary analysis

aiAnalyzer.title: AI Requirements Analyzer
aiAnalyzer.intro: An AI tool for deep thinking and requirement clarification, automatically breaking down vague ideas into structured fill-in-the-blank templates, helping users learn how to give AI better prompts. Suitable for product planning, project discussion, AI prompt engineering, and more.

features.0: After entering requirements, AI automatically generates structured analysis templates with guiding questions to help clarify goals, users, features, budgets, and core elements
features.1: Supports copying analysis results for direct use in ChatGPT, Claude, and other AI tools' prompt writing
features.2: Real-time error handling and loading status prompts for better interaction experience
features.3: Clean interface with mobile device browsing support
features.4: Integrated Google Gemini API ensuring analysis quality and diversity

newDictionary.title: New Dictionary
newDictionary.intro: An online Chinese dictionary application connecting to MOE Dictionary data source, aiming to optimize Chinese vocabulary learning and query experience. Independently completed project design, development, and deployment from scratch.

features.0: Connected to 'MOE Dictionary' API for real-time word definition queries with dynamic routing for word-URL synchronization
features.1: Self-designed UI from scratch with Tailwind CSS for cross-device responsive interface (RWD)
features.2: Developed with Next.js and TypeScript ensuring type safety and excellent developer experience
features.3: Used Redux Toolkit for global state management with Thunk for async API data fetching

tzuchiShop.title: Buddhist Product Display Static Website
tzuchiShop.intro: A practical project exploring AI collaborative development workflow. The goal is to build a professional, modern, and fully responsive product display website from scratch using AI tools in a very short time.

features.0: Actual result: Completed the full process from design to deployment in 3 working days, successfully validating the high efficiency of AI-assisted development
features.1: Tech stack: Built with Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS, deployed and hosted globally via Vercel
features.2: Website features: Implemented pure static product category switching, product hover interaction effects, with complete responsive design (RWD)

reactBlog.title: React Blog System (Learning Project)
reactBlog.intro: This is my earliest complete independent development application, aiming to practice a full-stack blog system with complete backend management features. The project covers user authentication, complete article CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) workflow, and frontend error handling mechanism, laying a solid foundation for handling complex web applications.

features.0: Integrated Google Firebase Authentication for secure third-party login and user identity verification
features.1: Implemented complete article management workflow including permission-based article publishing, editing, and deletion (CRUD) backend features
features.2: Built single-page application (SPA) with React Router, managed async operations and global state with Redux Thunk
features.3: Refactored with React Hooks in later stages, greatly simplifying component logic and improving code readability and maintainability

arisanWebsite.title: Company Official Website
arisanWebsite.intro: Led the frontend development of the company official website (www.arisan.io), independently responsible for transforming design mockups into high-precision, high-performance interactive web pages. All UI components in this project were handcrafted from scratch for optimal customization and performance.

features.0: Responsible for core page development: Independently completed development of 'Service Overview', 'Product Introduction (Clio, Faceta)' three main pages and site-wide form functionality
features.1: Precisely implemented UI/UX: Built highly maintainable SCSS architecture using BEM (Block, Element, Modifier) methodology with 4K high-resolution screen support
features.2: Optimized user interaction: Used React Context API for global popup forms and developed smooth scroll-to-section functionality
features.3: Introduced automated testing: Integrated Jest and Puppeteer for end-to-end (E2E) testing connected to GitLab CI/CD workflow ensuring quality for each deployment
